model: SERAPIS (modular inflation; vacuum at a fixed point of the torus shape)
status: Frozen predictions, scored only on data published after 15 Nov 2026. A proposed model, not an established result.
star_mapper_role: The Star Mapper does not test SERAPIS (an early-universe model makes no prediction for individual Milky Way stars). It is the project's open-data survey: it verifies Gaia DR3 against ESA and feeds the AEGIS Sky Map with flagged stars and discovery categories (rules locked in PREREG_D716).
changed_since_freeze: D719–D725: SERAPIS-E at ρ needs a 2⊕1 heavy-neutrino sector; reheating 3e8–3e9 GeV; frozen n_s, r bands still hold
D723: the simplest (doublet-only) neutrino sector at ρ is ruled out (dark radiation)
D727–D730: at τ = i the inflaton is not sterile; reheating ~1–3e6 GeV; the τ = i frozen band is met only for a narrow ε
D728/D738: leptogenesis from inflaton decay works at ρ, marginal at τ = i (Affleck–Dine remains the route there)
D732–D736: post-hoc wino prediction 0.67–0.80 TeV (~15% of dark matter), testable by LHC Run 3 / HL-LHC
D739: Heavy-ν sector at ρ: 2⊕1, weight-2 mixing → computed
